newsitem.title: HAITI: Former Korean diplomat shot dead in Haiti.
newsitem.headline: Former Korean diplomat shot dead in Haiti.

text.p: A gunman shot and killed a former South Korean diplomat in downtown Port-au-Prince in what was believed to be an attempted robbery, police said on Tuesday.

Yoon Ki Song and his wife were driving through the downtown area on Monday carrying a suitcase stuffed with money. The former diplomat, who owned businesses in the capital, was shot four times and his wife was shot once in the thigh.

An angry crowd gathered and the gunman fled to the harbour, where he jumped in the water, stole a boat and rowed out to sea. Bystanders said they heard shots but it was unclear if the boat's owner was killed.
National Port Authority agents caught the gunman and turned him over to "Around Christmas time we always see heightened criminal activity," Police Chief Pierre Denize said.
Police are still investigating other recent killings.

The bodies of four unidentified people killed on Friday night were found on Sunday in Tabarre suburb and police are treating the slayings as executions as the victims were shot in the head and back. Two weeks ago, the bodies of four men were found in piles of garbage in the Cite Soleil slum area. The men were known drug dealers.
